newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice closes higher on cash connected demand.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice closes higher on cash connected demand.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed higher on cash-connected commission house buying, traders said.
Traders expressed surprise at the ability of rice to hold to the current strong levels in the wake of a disappointing U.S. rice export number in Thursday's USDA weekly export sales report.
Rice futures volume was estimated by CBOT at 500 contracts, below the 729 traded Thursday.
Rice closed four to 7-1/2 cents higher, with March up 4-1/2 at $12.18-1/2 per cwt.
